page.overview:
Who is Pango Small?

Pango Small is a giant guardian and a member of the Menagerie, a small group of adventurers. He is played by Sam Riegel in .

Pango is a 7 or 8 feet tall giant of purple skin, two eyes and a big nose. He wears stolen green clothes.

Pango is somewhat shy, and easily embarrassed, particularly in front of Bunnie.

Pango grew up underground with his family. At some point, a red substance, the "seep", covered his home, trapping many of his people, including his brother Wango. Eventually, he teamed up with the Menagerie and became an adventurer.
